sections.heading: In-Game Description
sections.text:
Sacred passage on a path to enlightment.
"Undying, I pray for the Dragon's return. Undying, lo, let us wait an age; for the Divine Heir to assimilate the cold dragon tears; for the cradle to consume the pair of serpentine fruits.
Let the cradle endure, giving Him shelter; granting His return to the west."

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text:
This item will only appear after the Divine Child of Rejuvenation suggests that Wolf speak with the old High Priest of Mt. Kongo.
Required for the Return Ending.
